payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Connect your payment provider so customers can pay directly during checkout. CRM never touches the money — payments flow straight to your provider account, and refunds are processed through the provider's API when you handle returns.

providers.stripe: Global card payments — 50+ countries, Stripe Payment Intents + Refunds API
providers.paypal: PayPal Orders v2 — works in 200+ markets, capture + refund
providers.adyen: Enterprise unified payments — 250+ payment methods, hosted Drop-in
providers.braintree: PayPal-owned full-service gateway — cards + PayPal + Apple Pay + Google Pay
providers.square: In-person + online payments — US, UK, AU, CA, JP, IE
providers.mollie: European gateway — iDEAL, Bancontact, SOFORT, SEPA, cards
providers.razorpay: India + South Asia gateway — cards, UPI, wallets, EMI
providers.paddle: Merchant of record for SaaS — handles tax + invoicing globally
providers.paybox: Kazakhstan acquiring — KZT cards + KaspiPay + EasyPay
providers.manual: No API integration — cash, bank transfer, etc. Refunds are record-only
providers.other: Free-form provider — record references manually in Returns workflow

panel.modeTestHint: No real money will be charged — use the provider's test cards.
panel.modeLiveHint: Real card charges will be made. Switch to test mode for development.

hint.stripe: Process card payments globally. Test mode keys work without real money.
hint.paypal: PayPal Orders v2 API. Sandbox keys → test accounts; live keys → real money.
hint.adyen: Adyen Unified Commerce platform. Use test API key for sandbox, then switch to live. HMAC key signs webhooks.
hint.braintree: PayPal Braintree GraphQL API. Sandbox merchant_id starts with letters; live ids look different. Webhooks signed via private_key.
hint.square: Square Connect APIs. Use sandbox access_token (EAAAEy…) for testing; webhook_signature_key signs notifications.
hint.mollie: Mollie supports iDEAL, Bancontact, SEPA, cards. API key prefix (test_/live_) selects the mode automatically. Webhooks unsigned — we re-fetch payment status to verify.
hint.razorpay: Razorpay for India + South Asia. key_id is safe to expose on the frontend; key_secret stays on backend. Webhook secret signs notifications with HMAC-SHA256.
hint.paddle: Paddle Billing (new API). Merchant of record — handles VAT/tax globally. Catalog products usually required; non-catalog mode works for ad-hoc cart amounts.
hint.paybox: PayBox.money — Kazakhstan-focused acquiring. Supports KZT cards, KaspiPay, EasyPay. Signature-based auth (SHA1 over sorted params + secret_key).
hint.manual: No API. Orders recorded as payment_status="manual", refunds are record-only — you process money externally (cash / bank transfer).
hint.other: For providers we haven't integrated. You'll need to manually record references in the Returns workflow.
